claimChecks.claim: Mechanical obstruction, pregnancy, inability to operate, diathermy and bleeding are identical universal contraindications
claimChecks.locator: Manufacturer indications, contraindications and warnings lines 325-346
claimChecks.note: Mechanical obstruction outside InterStim urinary intended use; pregnancy safety not established; diathermy, absent response and inability to operate labeled contraindications; bleeding assessed rather than invented universal absolute rule.

claimChecks.claim: FI response improves or is maintained from 79% short term to 84% at >36 months within one cohort

claimChecks.note: Modest six-month difference, similar sustained 24-month improvements; 200 U studied is not ordinary 100 U idiopathic-OAB labeling.
